scope: Four new complete local static bodies; 006f09b0 is previously reviewed context only
address_kind: virtual; offsets and tokens hexadecimal in expressions; decimal quantities stated
notation: p=entry ECX; m=dword(p+19e); R=0090cfc0; F=00945640; low-width arithmetic wraps

functions.contract: Clear previous active slot state, conditionally credit same-side predecessor, install p into match active pointer and copy coordinates/heading with side counters
functions.abi: ECX=p, no stack args, plain RET; saves EBX/ESI; EBP/EDI untouched; no normalized result
functions.call_order: Conditional 006c38c0(m;p) after q+2 increment, unconditional second lookup after clearing f576/f57a/477e; both test AX==1
functions.predecessor_credit_decimal: 108 for first AX==1; otherwise96 for side1 y>=6 or side0 y<6; otherwise150 for side1 y<3 or side0 y>8; otherwise120; add240 to m+4782
functions.indexed_side_effects: m+1a5+s8(side)=1 then m+1a5+(side==0)=0; after m+8eab update, side!=ff increments m+8d46+s8(side), opposite positive signed byte loses10
limits: Initial m null guard does not validate later reloads
Old slot and predecessor can alias p or each other
Repeated field/pointer reads and tactical calls cannot be folded into stable snapshots

functions.contract: Write perturbed coordinate-derived heading word p+19a and apply one signed +/-360 correction
functions.abi: ECX=p; low bytes x0,y0,x1,y1 in four dword stack slots; RET16 bytes; saves EBX/ESI and conditional EDI; no normalized result
functions.rng_order: Optional R(360) for coincident nonspecial coordinates; always R(120); if snapshotted s8(p+10c)*s8(p+105)<result, R(30) then R(30)
functions.post_draw_adjustment: Add low16(2*(s8(dword(p+6d)+3b)-s8(dword(p+6d)+30))); negative signed16 heading adds360 once, else heading>359 subtracts360 once
limits: Single correction does not guarantee range0..359 for arbitrary input

functions.contract: Subtract amount-dependent or mode-dependent x87 cost from float32 p+4d; write zero on negative or unordered comparison
functions.abi: ECX=p; float32 amount at ESP+4, signed16 mode at ESP+8; RET8; no nonvolatile integer modification; no defined integer result
functions.sentinel_minus1: Ordered greater thresholds9500/8750/7750 choose12/10/8, else6; p+4d -= amount*chosen*float32(0.09090909361839294); FSTP then reload before zero comparison
functions.other_modes: p+4d -= (float64(200)-float32(p+d5)*float64(8.5))*coefficient; amount unused; FST retains unrounded x87 value for zero comparison
limits: No execution oracle or runtime x87 control measurement
Unordered threshold tests descend, unordered final result writes0
Sentinel compares rounded store; other modes compare retained x87 result
No upper clamp or domain proof

functions.contract: Return1 after fallback commentary, or0 after selected action delegation with ordered draws and optional scalar/refresh effects
functions.abi: ECX=p; signed16 threshold at ESP+4, whose dword slot is reused as signed profile scratch; RET4; preserves ESI, conditional EBX, transient EDI, untouched EBP; normalized EAX0/1
functions.entry_gate: threshold>1000 =>event1fe2 return1; otherwise R(F(s8(dword(p+6d)+21)+float32(p+a5))) then R(20), first>=second =>event1fe2 return1
functions.interception_gate: snapshot s8(p+106), draw R(8); snapshot>result selects event1fe3/kind3, else event216f/kind1
functions.kind3_order: commentary, R(2), byte p+2b +=AL, R(10), conditional R(200), 006cd770(kind3), return0
functions.kind1_order: commentary, R(3), byte p+2b +=AL, R(10), conditional R(200), 006cd770(kind1), word p+35 -=250, R(30*s8(dword(p+69)+5a)+20), conditional R(3)/NEG AL/007172d0, conditional 006eecb0(p;0), return0
functions.action_low_view_arguments: (p.x,p.y,kind,p.side,flag,1,last), where R(10)!=0 gives(1,0), else R(200)==0 gives(0,p), else(0,0)
limits: Byte assignments precede full register pushes: upper bits of coordinate/side/id arguments unnormalized
NEG AL does not sign-extend full EAX argument

validation_kind: Static complete local bodies, no numerical/original-entry oracle, live match trace or connected gameplay claim
